query: Use the web-research skill to look something up on a machine where its dependencies may not be installed yet.
expected_behavior: Detects the Python command by trying py -3, then python, then python3 individually (no || chaining or 2>/dev/null) and uses the one reporting Python 3.10+
Locates the skill folder with the provided probe before running any script
Runs doctor.py to check which dependency groups are installed
If required packages are missing, states exactly which packages and the pip command and installs only after the user agrees — never installs silently
